## MockTelegramServer class

In-process mock Telegram API server for local testing.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare class MockTelegramServer 
```

## Remarks

Provides a minimal subset of the Telegram Bot API for local development. It does not emulate network delays, rate limits, or full Telegram behavior.

## Example


```typescript
const server = new MockTelegramServer()
await server.start()
console.log(server.apiRoot)
await server.stop()
```
